questions.question: It was only when the manager arrived that the employees began to work more efficiently. The statement suggests that:
options: The manager's arrival had no impact on employee productivity.
The employees were already working efficiently before the manager arrived.
The manager's presence is essential for employees to perform well.
The employees' lack of motivation was not the manager's responsibility.
questions.answer: It was only when the manager arrived that the employees began to work more efficiently. The statement suggests that: The manager's presence is essential for employees to perform well.

questions.question: The new policy, which had been implemented six months ago, has already shown significant improvements in student performance.
options: The policy was not effective.
The policy was only recently introduced.
The policy's success is due to the hard work of teachers.
The policy has been in place for less than a year.
questions.answer: The new policy, which had been implemented six months ago, has already shown significant improvements in student performance.

questions.question: Unless I finish this project by Friday, I'll have to work over the weekend.
options: I will definitely complete the project on time.
There's no need for me to worry about meeting the deadline.
I'm not sure if I can finish it in time.
It's unlikely that I'll be able to finish the project by Friday.
questions.answer: Unless I finish this project by Friday, I'll have to work over the weekend.

questions.question: The fact that she was unable to attend the meeting was not surprising, given her poor health.
options: Her attendance at the meeting would have been a miracle.
She had no reason to miss the meeting.
It's unfortunate that she wasn't there.
Her absence from the meeting was expected.
questions.answer: The fact that she was unable to attend the meeting was not surprising, given her poor health.

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left.
options: I'm sure everyone stayed until I got there.
The party was still in full swing when I arrived.
It's a shame more people didn't stay to meet me.
My arrival marked the beginning of the end for the party.
questions.answer: By the time I arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left.
